unconsolidated_prose.title: Track B2 — Connection finder
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Weekly cron reads last 7 days of memories and finds non-obvious connections to older entries.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track B3 — Queue processor
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Watch knowledge/memories/queue/ for RESEARCH/SYNTHESIZE/DRAFT tasks and process every 2h via Ollama or Claude.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track B4 — Weekly synthesis
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Sunday 8 PM cron runs a 4-question retro: what moved, what didn't, emerging patterns, top-3 next-week leverage.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track B5 — Project auto-updater
unconsolidated_prose.intent: On project subfolder file change, auto-update the project's overview.md with a one-line change summary.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track B6 — Knowledge distillation
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Monthly cron distills 30 days of resources/areas notes into a single canonical reference per topic cluster.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track C1 — HTML output mode
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Add --html flag to generate-claude-brief / generate-system-viz / build-state-snapshot for info-dense HTML alongside markdown.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track C2 — HTML dashboard
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Unified HTML dashboard aggregating system-viz, CLAUDE-BRIEF, BUILD_STATE, scrutiny ledger, recall, chat-bus, workboard; regenerated on Stop.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track C3 — HTML design system
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Extract a PRISM design system HTML reference from mcp-server/web/ so subsequent HTML generations match style.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track D1 — Provenance layer
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Every memory/wiki entry gets source frontmatter (agent, sessionId, writeEvent, parentMemory); memory-mirror enriches on write.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track D2 — Ontology layer
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Explicit type tagging (fact|interpretation, current|deprecated|draft, public|internal|confidential) via Zod-validated frontmatter.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track D3 — Conflict resolution
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Capture concurrent same-key memory edits in conflicts/<key>.diff.md with last-writer/first-writer/human-arbitrate policies.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track D4 — Action traces
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Log every agent write as a graph edge in an append-only JSONL ledger, queryable from system-viz.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track D5 — Context eval gate
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Before an agent acts on memory, eval whether retrieved context was complete vs a golden set; block/warn on coverage drop.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track E1 — IdeaBlock extractor
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Convert memory/wiki .md into IdeaBlocks (question + validated answer per atomic claim) via Ollama structured output.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track E2 — IdeaBlock dedup
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Iterative cosine-similarity dedup at 80-85% threshold over 3-5 rounds, collapsing near-duplicates into canonical blocks.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track E3 — IdeaBlock RAG engine
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Replace ObsidianMemoryRagEngine's chunk-window approach with IdeaBlock matching for ~2.3x retrieval relevance.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track E4 — IdeaBlock governance
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Auto-tag each block with clearance level, version state, product line, export-control flags (machine-applied).

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track F1 — Voice capture
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Whisper local bridge for operator voice memos into tribal knowledge ingest; phase 1 is a .wav/.mp3 watcher to inbox.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track F2 — Highlights-only PDF ingest
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Add --highlights-only flag to /pdf-learn to extract only PDF highlight annotations, cutting ingest noise ~90%.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track G1 — Agent job descriptions
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Codify narrow job descriptions per subagent type to replace vibe agents with specific role definitions.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track G2 — Agent pixel-dept overlay
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Extend system-viz with an agent-status overlay (idle/typing/parsing/errored) pulled from chat-bus heartbeats.

unconsolidated_prose.title: Track G3 — Agent runtime alerts
unconsolidated_prose.intent: Watchdog hook alerts via PushNotification if a subagent runs >N min without progress, built on the chat bus.
